name: Synthesia
shortDescription: AI avatar videos from a script. Basic is free, and Starter is $29 a month.
longDescription: Synthesia's homepage says it creates studio videos with AI avatars and voiceovers. The pricing page lists Basic at $0 a month, with no credit card, and says those videos carry a watermark. Starter is $29 a month when billed monthly.
pricingNotes: Basic is $0 a month. Starter is $29 a month when billed monthly, from the pricing page on 2026-10-19.
freeTierNotes: Basic includes a free monthly video allowance and says no credit card is required. Those videos carry a watermark.
bestFor: An avatar video from a script without filming
A free Basic plan to try a stock avatar
notIdealFor: Cutting a long stream into shorts
strength: Synthesia's homepage says it creates videos with AI avatars from a script, and Basic is free with no credit card.
weakness: Starter is $29 a month when billed monthly, and the free plan's videos carry a watermark.
smokeTestNotes: Homepage, pricing page, and avatar page reviewed on October 19, 2026.

useCaseFit.avatar-video: Generates an avatar video from a script and a stock or custom avatar.
